title: Evaluation of the power-sum polynomial
statement: Let $n,\ell$ be nonnegative integers with $\ell>0$, let $m$ be a length-$\ell$ vector over $\mathbb F_2$ for which $X^\ell+\sum_{j<\ell}m_jX^j$ is irreducible, and let $\gamma\in\mathbb F_2^n$ and $r\in\mathbb F_2^\ell$. In the quotient obtained by adjoining a root of that polynomial, encode the vector $\sum_{i<n}\gamma_i r^{i+1}$, where powers and scalar multiples are computed in the length-$\ell$ modular representation, by its low-coefficient polynomial. This encoding equals the value at the encoding of $r$ of the polynomial $\sum_{i<n}\gamma_i X^{i+1}$, with coefficients mapped into the quotient.
hypotheses_covered: The modulus polynomial determined by $m$ is irreducible
$\gamma$ is a length-$n$ vector over $\mathbb F_2$
$r$ is a length-$\ell$ vector over $\mathbb F_2$
